gatoh.graphs.graphs.Graph.remove_edge

Graph.remove_edge(from_node: int, to_node: int) → None[source]

Removes a single edge from the graph.

Throws a warning without interrupting the runtime if the edge did not exist in the first place.

Parameters:

  • from_node (int) – the parent node in the edge.

  • to_node (int) – the child node in the edge.

Raises:

UserWarning – If the edge (from_node -> to_node) does not exist in the Graph.
